As a lawsuit may comprise numerous claims made by and against numerous parties, not every dispositive motion seeks to dispose of the entire lawsuit.  In the U.S., the most common type of dispositive motions seeking to dispose of the entire lawsuit are those for summary judgment. The other party may respond with counter-declarations, discovery responses, and legal arguments attempting to show that these issues were "triable issues of fact."
